mathematical_claim: A fixed membership-only Mathlib first-order formula Phi(K), interpreted in ZFSet at the initial-ordinal code of any cardinal kappa, is equivalent to independently defined complete filter extension. At regular kappa it is equivalent to the predecessor residual schema. Exact set coding preserves all subsets, families, small-cardinal bounds, filters, ultrafilters, relative intersections and extensions. No existence assertion or object-language ZFC derivation is supplied.
input_domain: Mathlib membership-only first-order syntax, the concrete ZFSet universe, universe-polymorphic cardinal parameters, exact set graphs and filters; inherited residual and integer algebra.
tested_surrogate: Fresh proof elaboration, exhaustive named theorem axiom audit, predecessor source equality, expected rejection controls. Mathematical universal conclusions derive from the proof terms, not from finite enumeration.

bounds.build_strategy: Clean serial topological Lake targets, followed by complete root target

pass_means: Every compilation succeeds, every named theorem is audited, axiom dependencies satisfy the standard allowlist, input hashes are unchanged, predecessor theorem sources match, and false proof and placeholder controls are rejected for the expected reasons.
failure_means: No final PASS or claim that all proofs checked. Compiler, audit, integrity or resource failures must be reported separately.
non_claims: No proof of an uncountable compactness cardinal or new consistency strength.
No object-language derivation from ZFC, interpretation in every model of ZFC, relative consistency or independence theorem.
The membership formula has one free set parameter; the regular-uncountable existence guard has not been encoded and interpreted.
No identification of the integer cokernel with Mathlib right-derived limits.
